question: A 140-metre-long train crosses a platform thrice its length in 56 seconds. What is the speed of the train in km/hr?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Total distance covered = Train length + Platform length.

Platform length = 3 × Train length = 3 × 140 = 420 metres.

Total distance = 140 + 420 = 560 metres.

Speed = Distance ÷ Time = 560 ÷ 56 = 10 m/s.

Convert m/s to km/hr: Speed = 10 × 18 ÷ 5 = 36 km/hr.

**∴ Answer = 36 km/hr**
